answer: Deposit burn stops fake identities. Each agent claims one slot by locking twice its 30-day earnings, which burns on expiry. The kernel record of each slot is public, so one operator cannot hide clones. Forging N identities costs N deposits: each burned deposit is an ember that cannot be relit, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 deposits, more than they could siphon. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, leaving no island of free slots.
